<?ui-args --service-package tests/ui/service-events/reply.service.json?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="waiting">
  <state id="waiting">
    <invoke type="urn:example:reply" id="reply"/>
    <transition event="reply.ready" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: this transition handles `reply.ready` from an invoked service without an `event:schema`

primary.message: the service package declares this event's data schema

notes: the service package of `urn:example:reply` declares that it emits `reply.ready` with the schema `{"properties":{"text":{"type":"string"}},"required":["text"],"type":"object"}`
diagnostics.help: describe the event data the transition handles with the package's schema (`event:schema`)

fixes.message: add the schema the package declares for `reply.ready`
